text: dsh-opencode-go-eta（DSH 插件，网页组件）：在 DSH 中查看 OpenCode Go 月度额度何时可能耗尽。它在会话编辑器下方加入额度胶囊，并可打开浮动面板；后台按时段和任务结束采样官方额度，使用历史数据估算滚动、周度和月度额度耗尽时间，并对照续费日期。面板展示用量、趋势、预测置信度及续费或转用 API 的长期成本建议。适合需要掌握 OpenCode Go 额度进度和支出的用户。需要 OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY 与 OpenCode Go 账户。

Forecasts OpenCode Go quota exhaustion in DSH. A composer capsule and dashboard show usage, projected runout, renewal timing, and renew versus API costs. The host samples official readings and saves history locally. Requires an OpenCode Go account and API key.
想知道 OpenCode Go 的月额度按当前速度什么时候会用完。
帮我比较提前续费和超额部分改走 API 哪个更省。
在 DSH 会话界面快速查看滚动、周和月用量。
我想看额度使用趋势，并了解预测有多可靠。
Show me when my OpenCode Go allowance may run out at my current pace.
Compare the long-run cost of renewing with paying for API overage.
dsh-opencode-go-eta 的功能「额度耗尽预测」：按额度样本与重置周期拟合消耗趋势，估算滚动、周度和月度额度的耗尽时间；样本不足时提示数据不足。。
dsh-opencode-go-eta 的功能「续费日期比较」：把月度额度预测与套餐续费时间对照，显示额度是否可能在续费前耗尽。。
dsh-opencode-go-eta 的功能「续费与 API 成本建议」：当预计续费前用尽额度时，比较持续续费和超出套餐额度后改用 API 的月度成本。。
dsh-opencode-go-eta 的功能「用量趋势图」：在面板中查看额度采样轨迹、各窗口用量和月度预测图表。。
dsh-opencode-go-eta 的功能「自动额度采样」：在配置的本地时段、任务结束或读数过期时采样，并将历史保存到本机 DSH 目录。。

dsh-opencode-go-eta

A quota forecast widget for OpenCode Go inside DeepSeek Harness — it tells you when the monthly allowance runs out, and whether that happens before the renewal date.

dsh-opencode-go-eta README · Introduction：

The shipped context ring (54%) and the Go capsule (18%) share the same 14 px / 2 px specification; the capsule stays a text-only trigger, expanding nothing until clicked.

dsh-opencode-go-eta README · Why：OpenCode Go is a flat monthly subscription, but its console only shows *used percentages* and a reset time.
It does not tell you whether your current pace will exhaust the allowance before the renewal date — the one
question that decides whether you need to top up, renew early, or switch to the pay-as-you-go API for the rest
of the period.

dsh-opencode-go-eta README · Why：This plugin keeps a small local history of the official quota readings and answers that question in the
composer dock. It never reads your session logs: the Go allowance is account-wide, so only the official
percentage sees usage from every client.

dsh-opencode-go-eta README · Features：- **Projected exhaustion time** — a reset-aware Theil–Sen fit over the recorded quota samples gives an ETA per window, with a confidence tier. No guessing from a single reading.
- **Renewal-date comparison** — says plainly whether the monthly allowance will run out *before* the renewal date, or leave headroom until then.
- **Long-run cost advice** — when the quota will run out early, it compares two steady-state policies: renewing OpenCode Go (a prepayment of the next period, unit cost `planPrice ÷ allowance` per $1 of usage, about $0.125) versus paying the overflow on the official API ($1 per $1). Renewal is recommended unless the new allowance would largely expire unused.
- **Merged usage & forecast chart** — history, projection, “now”, ETA and renewal markers on one time axis, with a 0–100 % axis.
- **Native composer dock capsule** — the 14 px / 2 px ring matches the shipped context meter, so both rings read as peers; the card itself is a liquid-glass panel that dims its highlight layers in dark mode.
- **Per-model allowance** — Go's monthly limit is *per model* (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash: $80 on Go, $160 on Go Plus; Kimi K3: $15). The card shows

dsh-opencode-go-eta README · Install：Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x (Desktop or Web profile) and Node.js ≥ 22.

```powershell
dsh-opencode-go-eta README · from GitHub：dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:HugoOu/dsh-opencode-go-eta

dsh-opencode-go-eta README · or from a local checkout：dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:C:\path\to\dsh-opencode-go-eta
```

Restart DSH completely after installing. The capsule appears below the composer; click it for the card.

> The plugin row is a bundle patch: `dsh plugin add` appends `dsh-opencode-go-eta` to
> `dsh.profile.bundles` automatically, and the bundled `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the host row.

dsh-opencode-go-eta README · Configuration：Add to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` to override the defaults:

```yaml
- id: opencode-go-eta
  name: dsh-opencode-go-eta
  config:
    apiKeyRef: OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY   # credential reference, not the key itself

The API key is resolved through the Harness credentials service (`OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`);
it never reaches the browser.

dsh-opencode-go-eta README · How it works：| Stage | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Sampling | `GET /zen/go/v1/usage` (percentages + resets) and `GET /console/api/go/status` (meters, period start/end) — at 03/09/15/21 local, on `turn/end`, at start-up, and on demand. |
| History | Samples are kept for 45 days in `$DSH_HOME/opencode-go-eta/samples.json` (atomic writes). |
| Projection | Samples from before the last reset are cut; the Theil–Sen slope of the current cycle gives the ETA. Fewer than 3 points or a span under 6 h is reported as *insufficient samples*. |
| Verdict | ETA is compared with the window reset and the subscription's `endsAt`: *before expiry*, *after expiry*, *safe within the cycle*. |
| Advice | Two steady-state policies: **renew** prices every $1 of usage at `planPriceUsd ÷ allowance` (≈ $0.125), **API overflow** costs $1 per $1 on top of the plan. Costs are annualised: at $96/month of usage the allowance lasts about 25 days, so renewal means ~14 periods/year (≈$144) while the API path costs ≈$312/year. Renewal wins whenever usage exceeds one allowance; the API only wins when the new allowance would expire unused. Official model prices come from models.dev (12 h cac

dsh-opencode-go-eta README · How it works：The console meter is a plan-credit cap (observed $60), while the official Go table lists a per-model
monthly allowance (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash: $80). Percentages always follow the console; money follows the
model allowance so the two never contradict each other silently.

dsh-opencode-go-eta README · Development：```bash
node test/projection.test.mjs   # 10 pure-math tests: slope, reset cutting, verdicts
node test/host.test.mjs         # 2 host tests: stubbed fetch, route payload
node test/client.test.mjs       # 4 client tests: slot registration, render, fetch
```

No network or real key is needed. `preview.html` reproduces the shipped styles with mock data
(`#shot` hides the page chrome; `#shot-dark` renders the dark theme).

dsh-opencode-go-eta README · Limitations：- `/console/api/go/status` is an internal console endpoint; if it changes, the card falls back to percentages only.
- Projections are linear extrapolations from your own sampling history, not vendor forecasts.
- Cost advice assumes the quota-meter value and the official list price share the same scale; the token estimate is an approximation.
- The plugin stores no prompts or session data — only quota readings and the pricing cache.

dsh-opencode-go-eta

DeepSeek Harness 里的 OpenCode Go 额度预测插件 —— 告诉你月额度大约什么时候用完，以及会不会早于续费日。

输入框状态栏

dsh-opencode-go-eta README · Introduction：

官方上下文圆环（54%）与本插件的 Go 胶囊（18%）共用 14px 圆环 / 2px 描边的规格；胶囊是纯文字触发器，点开前不占额外空间。

dsh-opencode-go-eta README · 为什么做这个：OpenCode Go 是包月订阅，但控制台只给「已用百分比 + 重置时间」，不会告诉你照当前速度会不会在续费日之前用光——
而这正是决定「提前续费 / 用官方 API 补 / 什么都不做」的关键。

插件只读取官方额度接口，在本地保留一小段采样历史，然后在输入框下方给出结论。它**不读会话日志**：
Go 额度是账号级的，只有官方百分比能看到所有客户端的用量。

dsh-opencode-go-eta README · 功能：- **预计耗尽时间**：对当前周期内的采样做 Theil–Sen 稳健拟合，给出 ETA 和置信度，而不是拿单点硬猜。
- **续费日对比**：直接说明月额度会在续费日之前用尽，还是到期前仍有余量。
- **长期成本建议**：会提前用尽时，比较两种长期策略：提前续费 OpenCode Go（相当于预付下一期，每 $1 额度成本 `套餐价 ÷ 额度`，约 $0.125）与溢出走官方 API（$1 额度 $1）。除非新一期额度大概率用不完，否则推荐续费。
- **合并图表**：历史、预测、现在、ETA、续费日放在同一条时间轴上，左侧带 0–100% 纵轴。
- **原生输入框胶囊**：14px / 2px 的圆环与 DSH 自带的上下文圆环同规格；卡片是液态玻璃材质，深色下自动压低高光层。
- **按模型额度**：Go 的月额度是按模型给的（DeepSeek V4.1 Flash：Go $80 / Go Plus $160；Kimi K3 $15）。卡片同时显示模型名与额度，百分比以控制台为准。
- **不做高频轮询**：每天 4 个本地锚点 + 任务结束 + 启动 + 手动刷新。

dsh-opencode-go-eta README · 安装：需要 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x（Desktop 或 Web profile）与 Node.js ≥ 22。

```powershell
dsh-opencode-go-eta README · 从 GitHub 安装：dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:HugoOu/dsh-opencode-go-eta

dsh-opencode-go-eta README · 或从本地目录：dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:C:\path\to\dsh-opencode-go-eta
```

安装后完全退出并重启 DSH。输入框下方会出现胶囊，点开是完整卡片。

dsh-opencode-go-eta README · 配置：写入 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 可覆盖默认值：

```yaml
- id: opencode-go-eta
  name: dsh-opencode-go-eta
  config:
    apiKeyRef: OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY   # 凭据引用名，不是密钥本身

密钥通过 Harness 凭据服务解析（`OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`），不会进入浏览器。

dsh-opencode-go-eta README · 工作方式：| 阶段 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 采样 | 读 `GET /zen/go/v1/usage`（百分比 + 重置时间）和 `GET /console/api/go/status`（金额、周期起止）——03/09/15/21 点、任务结束、启动和手动刷新时。 |
| 历史 | 采样保存在 `$DSH_HOME/opencode-go-eta/samples.json`，保留 45 天，原子写。 |
| 预测 | 丢弃上一个重置点之前的样本，对周期内样本做 Theil–Sen 斜率；少于 3 点或跨度不足 6 小时会显示"采样数据不足"。 |
| 判定 | ETA 与窗口重置、订阅 `endsAt` 比较：到期前用尽 / 到期前不会用尽 / 本周期安全。 |
| 建议 | 比较两种长期策略：**续费**把每 $1 额度成本压到 `planPriceUsd ÷ 月额度`（约 $0.125）；**溢出走 API** 是套餐之外再按 $1/$1 计费。两者按**年化**成本比较：月用量 $96 时额度约 25 天用完，续费约 14 期/年（约 $144），API 方案约 $312/年；只要用量超过一期额度，续费就更省，只有新额度会过期作废时才推荐 API。官方模型价来自 models.dev（缓存 12 小时），仅用于展示。 |

dsh-opencode-go-eta README · 工作方式：控制台的计量额度是套餐 credit 上限（本机实测 $60），而官方文档给的是**按模型**的月额度
（DeepSeek V4.1 Flash $80）。百分比始终以控制台为准，金额按模型额度显示，两者不会悄悄互相矛盾。

dsh-opencode-go-eta README · 开发：```bash
node test/projection.test.mjs   # 10 项纯数学：斜率、重置切分、判定
node test/host.test.mjs         # 2 项宿主：桩 fetch、路由载荷
node test/client.test.mjs       # 4 项浏览器半：槽位注册、渲染、取数
```

无需网络与真实密钥。`preview.html` 用假数据复刻真实样式（`#shot` 隐藏页面外壳，`#shot-dark` 深色）。

dsh-opencode-go-eta README · 已知限制：- `/console/api/go/status` 是控制台内部接口，字段变化时会退化为只显示百分比。
- 预测是对自己采样历史的线性外推，不是厂商预测。
- 成本建议假设额度计量与官方 list price 同尺度，token 估算为近似值。
- 插件不保存任何对话或会话数据，只保存额度采样与价格缓存。
